title: Department storage has no effect on records

panels.caption: Agent (member of QA MF Dept) sees every record of a Department-storage module

rows.tavi: storageScope "department" saved, but records carry no department
Everyone sees all records (1, 2); department header ignored

notes: API: records created with no department, with x-department-id and with department_id all return 201; the list is identical with or without a department.
